_presets_note: Preset fields from the RISC-V Debug Spec (xml/dm_registers.xml, access=Preset). Values are the DUT's DECLARED parameters -- dm_pkg localparams and the hartinfo_t literal -- not values observed from RTL output. Sourcing them from the design's own configuration is what makes the model-vs-RTL comparison a real check: it verifies the RTL implements the parameters it was configured with.
_sbaccess_widths_note: dm_csrs.sv:551-555 derives every sbaccess* bit from BusWidth (>=8, >=16, >=32 ...), and Ibex instantiates the DM with BusWidth=32, so the DM reports 8-, 16- and 32-bit access supported. Declaring only sbaccess32 made every sbcs read a MODEL_MISMATCH (RTL 0x...407 vs model 0x...404) and, because one UVM_ERROR ends the run, aborted halt and sba before their verdicts.
_features_note: Optional features. Set one false to declare the feature absent: its registers are then unimplemented, which the spec says read 0, so the model predicts 0 and still compares every read.
_read_behaviour_note: progbuf_readable: whether progbuf0-15 read back what was written (the spec allows reads to return 0). haltsum_groups_present: whether haltsum1-3 exist (optional below 33 harts; absent they read 0). Both taken from this DM's DMI read decode.
